mapper.select: SELECT exercise_id, parts_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM exercises WHERE updated_at > #{updatedAt} AND owner_user_id IS NULL ORDER BY exercise_id, parts_id

SELECT exercise_id, owner_user_id, parts_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM exercises WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAt} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY exercise_id, parts_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercises(exercise_id, owner_user_id, parts_id, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{exerciseId}::uuid, #{ownerUserId}, #{partsId}, #{name}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (exercise_id) DO UPDATE SET parts_id=EXCLUDED.parts_id, name=EXCLUDED.name, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE exercises SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE exercise_id = #{exerciseId}::uuid AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
